# Akhil Vanga

> Senior UX and AI-first Product Designer based in Sacramento, California, with 12+ years of experience across aviation, healthcare, and government.

- [Axiom CI](https://www.akhilvanga.com/work/axiom-ci): AI-assisted contract and invoice review, evidence, and commercial decisions.
- [Design System](https://www.akhilvanga.com/design-system): Themeable React and TypeScript components, design tokens, and live examples.
- [UX Architect](https://www.akhilvanga.com/ux-architect): Interactive tool for product briefs, personas, journeys, and wireframe blueprints.
